project_title: Next.js 16 + Stripe Production E-Commerce & Webhook Architecture

aim.core_purpose: Enterprise-grade payment flow with idempotency webhook handling for high-performance commerce
aim.target_audience: Global B2C/B2B e-commerce teams and autonomous payment agents
aim.design_system: Bauhaus Minimalist (Bold price tags & clean grid)

primary_features: Stripe Checkout session creation via Server Actions
Idempotency Key based Stripe Webhook duplicate payment prevention
Supabase RLS secured digital product downloads
critical_rules: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY must only be used in Server Components/Actions, never client bundle
All payment webhooks must pass stripe.webhooks.constructEvent signature verification
Cart total must be recalculated server-side from DB prices, never trust client values

validation.done_criteria: Test card payment and webhook delivery result in DB order creation with Zero Build Error
test_cases: Stripe CLI webhook trigger (checkout.session.completed) updates DB order to PAID
Tampered payment amount payload rejected by server action (400)
Same webhook event replayed twice is idempotently handled without duplicate order
